settings.title: Our Story
settings.subtitle: A little shop with a lot of heart
settings.intro_heading: Beautiful Little Finds for Cosy Homes
settings.intro_text1: The Cosy Cairn began with a simple belief: that the smallest details can make a house feel like home. What started as a passion for collecting beautiful, comforting objects has grown into a carefully curated shop filled with pieces we truly love.
settings.intro_text2: Every item in our collection is chosen with intention. We look for quality craftsmanship, gentle materials, and that little spark of wonder that turns an ordinary moment into something special.
settings.intro_text3: From hand-poured candles and woven baskets to vintage-inspired tableware and soft textiles, each piece is something we would happily welcome into our own homes. We hope they bring the same warmth and joy to yours.
settings.values_subtitle: The values that guide everything we do
settings.val1_text: Every product is hand-selected for its beauty, quality, and ability to bring comfort.
settings.val2_text: We prioritise sustainable materials and plastic-free packaging wherever possible.
settings.val3_text: When you shop with us, you support a small business and the passionate makers we work with.
settings.val4_text: Each order is wrapped with love and sent in eco-friendly packaging to arrive safely.
